summary: G407 and G408: REPEATED CONTROL of 5+ SCORING ELEMENTS or of opponent NECTAR is likely STRATEGIC even with a sorting mechanism. R403: small decorative elements and gaps are okay if the number is legible from 12 ft. Also 10.8.4 FIELD Reset wording (not covered on this site).

edits.old: active pickup/intaking of more than 4 SCORING ELEMENTS.
edits.new:
active pickup/intaking of more than 4 SCORING ELEMENTS.

REPEATED instances of a ROBOT CONTROLLING 5 or more SCORING ELEMENTS are likely to be perceived as STRATEGIC, even if the ROBOT has a “keep 4 and discard the rest” sorting mechanism.

edits.old: A ROBOT may not CONTROL the opponent’s NECTAR.
edits.new:
A ROBOT may not CONTROL the opponent’s NECTAR.

REPEATED instances of a ROBOT CONTROLLING an opponent’s NECTAR are likely to be perceived as STRATEGIC, even if the ROBOT has a sorting mechanism that automatically discards opponent NECTAR by returning it to approximately its original state.

Small decorative elements and gaps in numbers are okay as long as the team number remains legible from 12 feet (3.65 meters) away and is discernable from a quick glance.
